title: 第一百零三章 残墟藏杀机域外首伐仙第一百零二章 撕裂诸天壁只身入苍茫
content_zh:
：踏入域外的刹那，浑身所有熟悉的道韵尽数剥离。
身后那道贯通纪元长河的天阙明光，隔着层层灰白雾气，显得遥远而温柔。那是我守护数年、浴血拼来的万古盛世，是我唯一的故土。
可一步跨出，便是两重天地。
域外没有日月，没有晨昏，没有山河地脉。
入目皆是无边无际的混沌灰茫，空气中漂浮着细碎的道体残屑、断裂的道器锈片、湮灭纪元的时空碎渣。
四周死寂得可怕。
没有风声，没有道鸣，甚至连生灵最基础的呼吸律动、天地灵气流转，一概全无。
有的，只是一种沉淀了亿万载的荒芜、冰冷、以及无处不在的压抑。
我微微蹙眉，五指虚握。
体内原本浩瀚无边、一念镇万古的**宰力量，在此刻被无形的域外大道强行压制大半。
长河天道作废，新旧秩序清零。
在这里，我不再是坐拥一界的诸天至尊，只是两个初入域外、道统不入主流的新生超脱者。
身旁，宋思雨轻轻呼吸了一口域外灰气，白皙的眉心微不可察地蹙了一下。
她抬手拢了下被虚空乱流拂乱的鬓边发丝，眸光沉静扫视四周无边残墟，声音压得极低：
“这里的道则很凶。”
“不是杀伐之凶，是……吞噬、同化、磨灭一切外道的霸道之凶。”
我点头，心底同样透彻。
纪元长河的道，是温柔衍化、轮回生灭。
而域外的道，是独尊其一、磨灭异己、万法归墟。
难怪亿万载以来，长河众生一旦超脱，便会悄无声息陨落。

不是战力不足，是道统不相容，天地在排斥你、磨灭你。
我微微松开紧握她的手，抬步缓步向前。
脚下无地，却似踏古台。
主宰道果内敛浮沉，黑白微光隐于体肤，不张扬、不外露，默默抵御着域外大道的侵蚀。
“小心。”我侧头轻声道，“这片残墟，不干净。”
越是死寂荒芜的古战场，越藏着蛰伏万古的杀机。
宋思雨轻轻“嗯”了一声，周身金色情道微光内敛，万千心念归于沉静，灵觉铺开到极致，替我探查四方隐秘凶机。
我们二人一攻一守、一探一镇，缓缓深入域外残墟腹地。
灰白虚空层层倒退，沿途随处可见崩碎的巨型神山残骸、断裂的至高道剑骨架、干涸的血色古池。
一眼望去，难以想象这里曾经爆发过何等层级的恐怖大战。
行走约莫百息。
嗡——！
一缕极阴、极冷、极刁钻的漆黑道息，自左侧千米外的残破古殿废墟之下，骤然窜出！
速度快如流光，杀机隐如鬼魅，直指我的后心神魂要害！
这一击，无声无息，无道韵波动，无杀气外泄。
content_en:
: The moment you step into the outside world, all the familiar Taoist charms from your body are stripped away.
Behind him, the bright light from the sky that penetrates the long river of era appears distant and gentle through the layers of gray mist. That was the eternal prosperous age that I had guarded for several years and fought with blood for, and it was my only homeland.
But take one step forward, and you will find two worlds.
Outside the territory there is no sun and moon, no morning and dusk, no mountains, rivers and earth.
All you can see is boundless chaos and gray, with fine Tao body debris, broken Taoist artifacts, and time and space debris from the Annihilation Era floating in the air.
It was eerily silent.
There was no sound of wind, no sound of Taoism, not even the most basic breathing rhythm of living beings and the flow of spiritual energy from heaven and earth.
Some are just a kind of desolation, coldness, and ubiquitous depression that have accumulated for hundreds of millions of years.
I frowned slightly and clenched my fingers.
The originally vast and boundless power of tyranny in the body, which could last forever with just one thought, was now forcibly suppressed by the invisible extraterrestrial avenue.
The long river of heaven and earth is abolished, and the old and new order is cleared.
Here, I am no longer the supreme being of all heavens who sits in a world, but just two new transcendent beings who have just entered the outside world and whose orthodoxy does not belong to the mainstream.
Beside her, Song Siyu took a gentle breath of extraterrestrial gray air, and her fair eyebrows frowned imperceptibly.
She raised her hand to tuck her hair around her temples that was messed up by the turbulent flow of the void. Her eyes calmly scanned the boundless ruins around her, and her voice was very low:
"The Tao here is very fierce."
"It's not a murderous evil, it's a domineering evil that...devours, assimilates, and obliterates all outsiders."
I nodded, with the same clarity in my heart.
The path of the long river of time is gentle evolution, reincarnation, birth and death.
The Tao outside the territory is to respect only one, eliminate all dissidents, and return all dharma to ruins.
No wonder that for hundreds of millions of years, all sentient beings in the long river will fall silently once they transcend.
It's not that you lack combat power, it's that your moral traditions are incompatible. The world is rejecting you and wiping you out.
I slightly loosened my grip on her hand and stepped forward slowly.
There is no ground under your feet, but it feels like stepping on an ancient platform.
The ruling Dao Fruit is restrained and ups and downs, the black and white shimmer is hidden in the body skin, unobtrusive and unexposed, silently resisting the erosion of the outer avenues.
"Be careful." I turned my head and whispered softly, "This ruins is not clean."
The more dead and desolate the ancient battlefield is, the more murderous intentions are hidden that have been dormant for eternity.
Song Siyu softly said "Hmm", the golden light around her body was restrained, thousands of thoughts returned to silence, and her spiritual sense was spread to the extreme to detect the hidden dangers in all directions for me.
The two of us attacked and defended, explored each town, and slowly penetrated into the hinterland of the ruins outside the territory.
The gray void is retreating layer by layer, and the shattered remains of giant sacred mountains, broken skeletons of the Supreme Dao Sword, and dried-up bloody ancient pools can be seen everywhere along the way.
At a glance, it is hard to imagine what level of horrific wars had broken out here.
It takes about a hundred breaths to walk.
Buzz—!
A wisp of extremely gloomy, extremely cold, and extremely tricky dark breath suddenly emerged from under the ruins of the dilapidated ancient palace a thousand meters away on the left!
The speed is as fast as a stream of light, and the murderous intention is as invisible as a ghost, pointing directly at the vitals of my heart and soul!
This blow was silent, with no ripples of Dao rhyme, and no murderous intent leaked out.
